notes.title: Demo update.
notes.content:
Demo update (restart steam / verify files if not getting the update). 
T-lock and shotguns were bugged in the demo, so releasing a small fix with some other updates that crept in since.

- T-lock was reapplying lock to a target mid flight and was more accurate at range than intended.
- Shotguns were not correctly being affected by bullet time and T-lock tracking.
- Reinstated damage numbers / alt colour for defense hits and deflections, should give better feedback for what your hits are actually doing.
- Weapons with enough penetration can shoot through security glass.
- 'Failsafe' perk reworked, should have use again.  Now gives disable and stun immunity for short duration on the debuffs being applied, but has a cooldown before subsequent activations.
- AI can now spawn with Failsafe.
- AI less likely to shoot through other AI.

notes.title: Demo update.
notes.content:
Demo update (restart steam / verify files if not getting the update). 
Servers will be down for a short duration.

- Removed knockdown from detonator and rockets.  Only prox mines and satchel charges should be able to knockdown.
- Fixed being unable to roll after dropping heavy weapon and picking up another primary.
- Minigun ammo back to 250 doubled with Surplus.
- Minigun accuracy increased, but now loses accuracy while firing.
- Refactored how maneuver cooldowns function, should hopefully be the end of the can't maneuver bug, they should also be more responsive.
- Stunt cooldown is less when performing a different stunt to the last.  eg. dive->slide will perform in quicker succession than dive->dive
- Corrected the jumping, was multiplying velocity causing speeds to build up on consecutive jumps.
- Made jumping more responsive, now registers if jump held when cannot actually jump and will perform as soon as available.
- Acrobatic now gives you 2 wall jump charges (reset both landing, somersault resets to 1), allowing you to more easily reach higher places.
- 'Maneuver state' is now considered for half a second after a maneuver ends, this will mostly only affect rolls/somersaults giving them some benefit to CR bonus and perks such as Kinetic focus.
- This happend a few patches back but was missed from notes.  Kinetic focus bonus is affected by speed during maneuvers rather than on/off.  Eg. higher bonus at a beginning of a slide, gradually lessening as you slow down.
- Bolster damage resistance reduced slightly.  Everyone knew this one was coming...
- Hydras vitals regeneration recovers burn damage.  I heard you, whoever it was...
- Bloodsport damage bonus is now proportional to vitals, with less damage the higher your vitals.  This is to reinforce the risk/reward nature of the perk.

notes.title: Demo update.
notes.content:
Thank you to all those that have backed the Kickstarter!

Last update to the demo is live (providing nothing is broken). 
PVP will be ending in around 5 days.  

- Added a temporary (totally not bodged in) objective to the demo!  Pick up and hold onto the intel to gain CR!, scan to see who currently has it! 
Note that this isn't a final game mode for the game, just something to play with for the last few days of the demo.
- CR can only be gained via the objective and from kills.
- Carrying the objective will impact movement speed and limit Dragons flight capabilities (for obvious reasons)
- Rhino gains passive melee + thrown projectile resistance (as with explosive resistance this only has an effect if defense > 0).  It will now no longer be possible to OHK a Rhino with the sword.
- Fixed an issue where defense wasn't preventing vitals damage in certain situations.
- Dragon gains ability to increase altitude by holding jump.  Drains 'stamina' quickly (stamina effects the strength of both air dash and the altitude gain).  Removed free flight during core as now obsolete.
This existed in the original prototype but was disabled pending tests.  Will make hovering feel less clunky moving around the environment and clearing obstacles etc.
- Hovering Dragons show up at further range on radar (can still be reduced with Low profile and removed with Shroud).
- Bolster duration from 10 - 5 seconds.
- Min loadout speed from 500 - 400.  This will mostly only affect certain Rhino loadouts.
- Fix for gaining momentum when sliding down slopes.
- As with laser sights, Akimbo now correctly receives less accuracy bonus from Kinetic Focus.
- FOV range increased to 120.
- Passive bots now use Player equivalent vital/defense stats.

- Added additional checks to make sure melee attacks cannot trigger during a roll or when knocked down.
- Maneuver impacts should now only trigger when hitting targets relative to the direction you are moving.
- Various smaller bug fixes.

notes.title: Demo update.
notes.content:
The demo now has amassed close to 65k downloads!  
The amount of positive feedback from the demo so far has been overwhelming and I'm excited to take this project to completion.

Here's an update with some tweaks and additions, some of which spawned from actually constructive feedback, which is nice to see!

- While diving or sliding you now retain some of your sideways movement input.  This is proportional to your current speed, with less control as you slow down.
- You can now lean while sliding
- Dodging now requires a minimum velocity before it will activate.  This prevents an exploit where people could get the combat rating bonus by 'dodging' into a wall without moving.
- All damage received while rolling is now considered limb damage.  This effectively means you take less damage while rolling giving it an incentive for situational use.
- Increased the roll speed slightly
- Reduced and smoothed out the loss of control slightly while rolling.
- Enabled one of the roll related perks 'Armadillo'.  This is primarily a defensive perk that will  enable projectile deflection while rolling, but also increase the damage you deal when rolling into enemies.
- Increased the maximum loadout speed from 750 to 800.  The minimum remains at 500 but this will give more freedom before reaching it.
- Increased the minimum maneuver speed.  This should result in maneuvers being more snappy while at lower speeds, while still not as effective when at faster speeds.
- Rhino AOE impact now only triggers if there is a target in range.  This is to prevent it triggering every time you land even when no one is around.
- Rhino AOE impact range increased slightly.
- Dragon defense reduced from 150 to 100,  due to the high mobility this shell already has.
- Quick melee now cancels reloading / chambering.
- Base level Nano-wire can no longer be disabled.  This is to prevent you being unable to pickup weapons when disabled.  UI icons and the benefits from Augmented Nano-wire can still be disabled.
- Trying to fire while out of ammo can now be cancelled by reloading.
- AI will now switch to melee if they are blocked from using their firearm.
- 'Drop weapon' input is now replaced with 'Throw weapon'.  Why drop your gun when you can throw it at the enemy!  Gains bonus from Augmented arms perk.  You will need to rebind this input.
- Various smaller fixes.

notes.content:
- Knives now have limited ammo.  This is not necessarily how they will stay, but they were far to strong to have an infinite supply.
- Adjusted some of the existing camera settings to help portray a sense of speed slightly and less 'floatiness' (they only originally kicked in when diving/sliding), following feedback from various sources.
